newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aon Corp started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aon Corp started as a buy.

text.p: - Mesirow Financial said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Aon Corp with a buy rating.

- Aon, an insurance brokerage and consulting company, could see earnings per share rise to $4.65 a share in 1998 if reasonable expense targets are achieved, Mesirow said. And Aon's earnings growth is expected to pick up in 1997. For 1996, Aon reported earnings of $2.87 a share including special items.
- Mesirow said the company's acquisitions of Bain Hogg and Alexander & Alexander have positioned Aon as one of the dominant global players in the insurance services industry.
